name: quickbooks
description: Read and write customers, invoices, bills, payments, and reports.

QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID.title: QuickBooks client ID
QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from your app's Keys & Credentials page at developer.intuit.com. Use the Development keys for sandbox and the Production keys for a live company.

QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: QuickBooks client secret
QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from the same Keys & Credentials page as the client ID.

QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: QuickBooks refresh token
QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token for the company to connect. For sandbox, generate one in the Intuit OAuth 2.0 Playground; for production, complete the one-time OAuth handshake described in the plugin README. The server rotates and persists it after first use.

QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID.title: QuickBooks company (realm) ID
QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID.description: Realm ID of the QuickBooks Online company the refresh token was issued for. Shown alongside the token in the OAuth 2.0 Playground and in the OAuth callback.

QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT.title: QuickBooks environment
QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT.description: Which Intuit environment the credentials belong to. Use sandbox for a developer sandbox company and production for a live company.
